secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing secret for JWT auth tokens. Generated for development; replace with your own for production.

secrets.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack Dashboard → Settings → API Keys & Webhooks; required for payment initialization and webhook verification.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Cloudinary Console → Dashboard → Cloud name; required for image uploads.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudinary Console → Dashboard → API key; required for image uploads.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
secrets.description: Cloudinary Console → Dashboard → API secret; required for image uploads.

secrets.name: EMAIL_HOST
secrets.description: Your SMTP/email provider's server hostname; required for transactional emails.

secrets.name: EMAIL_PORT
secrets.description: Your SMTP/email provider's port, typically 587 or 465.

secrets.name: EMAIL_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Your SMTP/email provider's account password or app password.

secrets.name: EMAIL_FROM
secrets.description: Verified sender email address with your SMTP provider.
